description_en: Calls the ModifyDataAgentTheme operation to modify the display name and description of a DataAgent theme. Passing null for a parameter value indicates that the corresponding field is not modified. Passing an empty string clears the field
description_zh: 调用 ModifyDataAgentTheme 接口修改 DataAgent 主题的用户展示名和描述。参数值传 null 表示不修改对应字段，传空字符串表示清空
name: ModifyDataAgentTheme

parameters.help_en: The business identifier of the theme
parameters.name: theme_id

parameters.help_en: The display name of the theme. Maximum length: 64 characters. A value of null indicates that the field is not modified. An empty string clears the field
parameters.help_zh: 用户展示名，最长 64 字符；null 表示不修改，空串表示清空
parameters.name: theme_name

parameters.help_en: The description of the theme. Maximum length: 255 characters. A value of null indicates that the field is not modified. An empty string clears the field
parameters.help_zh: 描述，最长 255 字符；null 表示不修改，空串表示清空
parameters.name: description
